name: lowcode-tools-migration-skill
description: Migrate test automation from mabl, Testim, Momentic, QA Wolf, Functionize and other low-code or managed test services to TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) in any language or framework. Covers mabl (CLI deployments, Playwright export), Testim (@testim/testim-cli, own-grid --host), Momentic (YAML tests, momentic run), QA Wolf (customer-owned Playwright repos), Functionize (model-based cloud tests), Selenium IDE .side files. Use this whenever someone wants to move, switch, port, migrate or point tests from low-code and managed test tools to TestMu AI or LambdaTest, asks what the TestMu or LT:Options equivalent is for a capability, config, CLI flag or API from low-code and managed test tools, mentions mabl, mabl tests export, Testim, testim-cli, Momentic, momentic run, QA Wolf, qawolf, or wants a migration plan, estimate, PR or checklist for a repo currently on low-code and managed test tools, even without the word migrate.
